tools.name: Claude Code
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based via Anthropic API; included with Claude Pro ($20/month) and Claude Max ($100/month) subscriptions; also available via Claude.ai and API pricing starting at $3 per million input tokens (Sonnet)
strengths: Agentic coding with full terminal and file system access
Handles large, multi-file refactoring tasks end-to-end
Strong reasoning and code explanation capabilities
Deep codebase understanding via context ingestion
Runs autonomously with minimal human intervention
Supports bash commands, git operations, and test execution
Excellent at greenfield project scaffolding
ide_support: Any editor accessible from command line
tools.best_for: Developers who want an autonomous AI agent to handle complex, multi-step coding tasks, refactoring entire codebases, or building features from scratch with minimal supervision

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.pricing_paid: Copilot Pro at $10/month or $100/year; Copilot Business at $19/user/month; Copilot Enterprise at $39/user/month; Free tier includes 2,000 completions and 50 chat messages per month
strengths: Deep GitHub and repository integration
Multi-model support (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini)
Copilot Workspace for issue-to-PR automation
Pull request summaries and code review assistance
Inline code completions with high accuracy
Copilot Chat for contextual Q&A
Extensive enterprise security and compliance features
Large ecosystem and community adoption
tools.best_for: Teams and enterprises already using GitHub who want tightly integrated AI assistance across the entire software development lifecycle from issue tracking to code review

tools.name: Cursor
tools.pricing_paid: Pro at $20/month (500 fast premium requests, unlimited slow requests); Business at $40/user/month with SSO and privacy controls; Free tier includes 2-week Pro trial then limited usage
strengths: Purpose-built AI-first code editor (VS Code fork)
Composer agent for multi-file edits in one session
Codebase-wide context and semantic search
Supports multiple frontier models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini)
Natural language to code with inline diffs
.cursorrules for project-specific AI instructions
Tab completion with predictive next-action suggestions
Strong context window utilization
tools.best_for: Individual developers and small teams who want the most deeply integrated AI coding experience and are willing to switch to a dedicated AI-native editor for maximum productivity

tools.name: Codeium (Windsurf)
tools.pricing_paid: Codeium Teams at $12/user/month; Codeium Enterprise with custom pricing; Windsurf Pro at $15/month; Free tier is generous with unlimited completions for individual use
strengths: Generous free tier with unlimited completions
Windsurf editor as an AI-native IDE alternative to Cursor
Cascade agentic AI with multi-step task execution
Fast and low-latency code completions
Broad language and framework support
Context-aware completions across the codebase
Self-hosted enterprise deployment options
Strong privacy guarantees with no training on user code
tools.best_for: Individual developers and startups looking for a powerful free alternative to Copilot with broad IDE support, or teams needing enterprise-grade on-premises deployment

tools.name: Amazon CodeWhisperer
tools.pricing_paid: CodeWhisperer Professional at $19/user/month; Free Individual tier available with no usage limits on code suggestions; Professional adds security scanning, SSO, and admin controls
strengths: Native AWS service integration and cloud-aware suggestions
Built-in security vulnerability scanning (OWASP, CWEs)
License and reference tracking for open-source compliance
Optimized for AWS SDKs, CDK, and CloudFormation
Supports 15+ programming languages
Strong Java, Python, and TypeScript support
Enterprise compliance and audit logging via AWS
Integration with AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB patterns
tools.best_for: AWS-centric development teams and enterprises building cloud-native applications on AWS infrastructure who need compliance-friendly AI assistance with security scanning

tools.name: Tabnine
tools.pricing_paid: Tabnine Pro at $12/user/month; Tabnine Enterprise at $39/user/month with on-premises hosting and custom model training; Free tier with basic completions
strengths: Privacy-first design with air-gapped and on-premises options
Custom model training on private codebases
Team learning that adapts to organizational coding patterns
Whole-line and full-function completions
Does not train on user code by default
Long-standing enterprise trust and adoption
Supports 80+ programming languages
Works offline with local model option
Compliance certifications (SOC 2, GDPR)
tools.best_for: Privacy-conscious enterprises and regulated industries (finance, healthcare, defense) that require on-premises deployment, custom model training on proprietary code, and strict data governance
